decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
1.	Approval of the details of the siting, design and external appearance of the building(s), the  landscaping of the site (hereinafter called "the reserved matters") shall be obtained from the local planning authority in writing before any development is commenced
(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

2.	Plans and particulars of the reserved matters referred to in condition 1 above, relating to the siting, design and external appearance of any buildings to be erected, the means of access to the site and the landscaping of the site, shall be submitted in writing to the local planning authority and shall be carried out as approved.
(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

3.	Application for approval of the reserved matters shall be made to the local planning authority before the 31 December 2006.
(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

4.	The development hereby permitted shall be begun  within two years of the date of approval of the reserved matters required by condition 3.
(Reason.  To prevent further continued uncertainty on the development of the site, and to allow the Local Planning Authority the ability to review the lands allocation for housing).

5.	Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.
(Reason.  In order not to prejudice the amenities of the adjoining properties and in order that the Local Planning Authority is able to exercise control over future development of the site in accordance with policy H6.4 Extensions and Alterations of the Hounslow UDP and policy H6.2 Environmental Improvements in residential areas)

6.	Before
description:
Ref:  01137/E P48 (P/2005/3615)
Development: Outline planning permission was granted on November 1999 for the partial demolition of existing hospital buildings, construction of new acute general hospital and development of surplus land for residential together with appropriate car parking, landscaping, the formation of a new access to Park Road and improvements to the Park Road/ Twickenham Junction.

Application for the approval of reserved matters shall be made to the local planning authority before the 31st December 2006.

The permission was received for a further year in 2005. Two applications have been submitted to renew that permission with regard to the surplus housing land.
